description.zh: 新的实例名称。名称为2~80个字符，以大小写英文字母或中文开头，不支持空格及特殊字符：`@/:=”<>{[]}`。
description.en: The new name of the instance. The name must be 2 to 80 characters in length. The name must start with a letter and cannot contain spaces and the following special characters: `@ / : = " < > { [ ] }`

description.zh:
[实例释放保护状态](~~165005~~)，取值：
* **true**：开启。
* **false**：关闭。

> 仅按量付费实例支持本参数。
description.en:
[Specifies whether to enable release protection for the instance.](~~165005~~) Valid values:

*   **true**: enables release protection.
*   **false**: disables release protection.

>  This parameter is available only for pay-as-you-go instances.

description.zh:
新的默认账号密码，默认账号为以实例ID命名的账号（例如r-bp10noxlhcoim2****）。
> 长度为8~32位，需包含大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符（支持`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`）中至少三种。
description.en:
The new password for the default account. The default account is named after the instance ID. Example: r-bp10noxlhcoim2\*\*\*\*.

> The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. These special characters include `! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`

descriptions.en: You can also modify the information of an instance in the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console. For more information, see [Change or reset the password](~~43874~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore modify-instance-attribute --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --instance-name newinstancename --new-password uW8+nsrp --instance-release-protection true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore ModifyInstanceAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceName newinstancename --NewPassword 'uW8+nsrp' --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --InstanceReleaseProtection true
